source_full_text: But the shepherd took a little flute out of the sleeve of his jacket and began to play a merry tune, on which the wild boars first of all shrank shyly away, And then got up on their hind legs and danced gaily. The shepherd would have given anything to be able to laugh, they looked so funny but he dared not stop playing,
